reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively instructs viewers to join a Bitcoin-funded trading account through a sponsor referral, select a team position, and submit payment and proof of payment. It presents the account as a paid trading membership with daily trading results and bonuses, while also directing participants to recruit friends and use downline registration, tying participation to a multi-level team structure.

citations.quote: Please check with your sponsor whether you should select the left or right-hand position.
Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer, it will appear in your trading account.
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
Should you wish to refer your friends you can send them your registration link

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker tells viewers to read and accept the terms before registering, rather than asking them to proceed without reviewing conditions. The registration confirmation also warns users not to share their login information and says the company will not ask for it. Those are limited safeguards, not proof that the service is sound, but they matter when assessing whether this video itself makes deceptive promises. Its account of funding is conditional on an administrator confirming the Bitcoin transfer. None of these steps promises a profit or guarantees a trading outcome.

citations.quote: Read the Terms and Conditions, and then click I have read and accepted the Terms and Conditions.
Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer, it will appear in your trading account.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies a sponsor, team placement and referrals, but those details do not establish that viewers are promised payment for recruiting. Nor does a daily statement establish profitable trades: the speaker calls it a statement of the results, without specifying what those results will be. The instruction to review the terms before registration is relevant context for a judge assessing what the video actually claims.

citations.quote: Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
Read the Terms and Conditions, and then click I have read and accepted the Terms and Conditions.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Terms acceptance and a warning about protecting login details do not address the concern raised by this video. The speaker instructs viewers to enter through a sponsor's referral link, choose a left or right team position, send Bitcoin and provide proof of payment. The absence of a guaranteed-profit claim does not make those recruitment and funding instructions merely cautionary.

citations.quote: You will need the referral link of the person who invited you join mirrortrading international
Please check with your sponsor whether you should select the left or right-hand position.
Upload the Proof of Payment screenshot, then click Submit.

opening.argument: Judge, the title identifies this as a guide to registering and funding an account, and the narration follows that workflow through registration, profile updates, funding and viewing statements. It even explains a practical payment detail: some wallets require email verification. The referral and downline controls appear as parts of the interface being demonstrated. Showing where those controls sit is different from claiming that recruiting earns a particular return. The most direct reading of the spoken material is an operational walkthrough; it does not establish any trading result for the viewer.

citations.quote: How to Register and Fund your Mirror Trading International Account
Please update your personal details and upload your proof of identity.
Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin, remember some wallets require you to verify the payment via email.
Click on the view option to see your daily statement.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening accurately describes what the tutorial demonstrates, but it treats demonstrating those controls as sufficient proof of a recruitment payoff. The narration says friends may be referred if the viewer wishes; it does not state that a recruit's payment produces income for the sponsor. Likewise, statements report trade results, not a specified return.

citations.quote: Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link, or you can help them register, by clicking on the downline registration link.
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling this a walkthrough does not make its instructions neutral. The description urges viewers to sign up, while the narration tells them to use an inviter's referral link, consult a sponsor about team placement and send Bitcoin to fund the account. It then shows how to pass a registration link to friends. Those are actionable participation and recruitment instructions, whether or not a specific payout is quoted.

citations.quote: Sign up today: ...
Please check with your sponsor whether you should select the left or right-hand position.
Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

opening.argument: Judge, the concrete transaction described here is a customer funding a trading account: the user sends Bitcoin, records the amount and transaction ID, and submits proof of payment for confirmation. The speaker then describes account statements reporting trading results. A referral link and team-position selector are present, but the supplied narration does not say that a sponsor receives money when someone joins, specify a commission rate, or promise that a deposit will grow. It is possible to regard the observed flow as promotion of a financial service without inferring an unspoken recruitment payout mechanism.

Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer, it will appear in your trading account.
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
Next you will see auto placement is displayed Please check with your sponsor whether you should select the left or right-hand position.

rebuttal.rebuttal: A left or right team position and an option to refer friends establish a referral structure, but the prosecution's conclusion about recruitment rewards requires a further step: evidence that recruiting produces a payout. Its quoted statement concerns trade results, not referral income. Even the funding step says the transferred Bitcoin appears in the user's trading account after confirmation; it does not say it is paid to the sponsor.

citations.quote: Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer, it will appear in your trading account.
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The argument asks the judge to overlook what the workflow connects. Registration depends on an inviter's referral link; the new member is placed in a sponsor's team leg; the dashboard displays team, referral and bonus fields; and the speaker instructs members how to refer friends. No commission rate needs to be stated for those features to show a tiered recruitment structure attached to the funded trading account.
